Class DinosaurCLI

java.lang.Object
DinosaurCLI
public class DinosaurCLI extends Object
Edgar Lopez CEN 3024C - Software Development 1 November 16, 2026 DinosaurCLI.java Provides a command-line interface for the Dinosaur Data Management System. Allows users to interact with dinosaur records through a text-based menu. The interface supports importing dinosaur records from a text file, displaying records, adding new dinosaurs, removing records, updating attributes, and searching or filtering dinosaur information. Connects the user interface to the DinosaurManager and DinosaurFileReader classes to support the application's data management functionality.
